model._multilevel: Fixed-quadtree QuadtreeHFM knobs (use_quadtree=true). d_patch/n_layers/patch_px/n_global_tokens above are legacy flat-HFM fields the quadtree ignores. ml_dims is a bell curve peaking at level 1; ml_passes is the non-increasing per-level self-attn budget (last = 'number of layers'). Tie/untie: ml_blocks_per_level gives each level that many distinct blocks cycled across its passes (1 = tied); ml_untie_passes=true overrides to one block per pass (fully untied, ~22.8M gen vs ~6M tied).
model._strides: Multi-timestep training. The physical timestep is dt = stride * save_t, and gen_alternating draws save_t per segment over 0.01..0.2, so dt is continuous and varies run to run WITHOUT any frame striding: hence time_strides=[1]. The probe REGRESSES log(dt) from the context (plus the BC summary) rather than classifying a stride index. stride_cls_weight scales that whole probe loss; 0.5 because at 0.1 the probe never learned the large timesteps and the model hedged with an average delta. persist_norm_loss=true trains on loss/persistence per rollout term so every dt contributes O(1) gradient rather than the large-dt samples dominating, i.e. the training objective becomes the logged ratio.
model._residual: residual_prediction=true: model predicts the frame-to-frame DELTA (out = x + f(x)); a zero-init decoder then starts at exact persistence. MUST match how the checkpoint being loaded was trained — inference on an absolute-trained checkpoint with this on doubles the field each step and explodes (infer.py --no-residual works around). mask_aware_decoder feeds the geometry mask to the decoder convs.
model._n_ctx_tokens: 16, down from 64. Effective rank of the learned summary table measured 14.7/64 on ckpt-step037500, so 64 tokens were ~4x redundant, and an ablation to k=16 cost about 10% of the ratio improvement.

training._sizing: Dawn PVC 1550, 1 node x 8 tiles (ZE_FLAT), ~64GB HBM/tile. batch_size is PER RANK: effective batch = 32 x 8 = 256. lr ~sqrt-scaled from 1e-4@bs4. Dataset is now ~645k sequences -> ~2520 steps/epoch, so 20 epochs ~= 50k optimizer steps and cosine_t_max matches that. IMPORTANT: CosineAnnealingLR is periodic — training past cosine_t_max makes the LR RISE again, so keep n_epochs x steps/epoch <= cosine_t_max.
training._settle_time: Sim-time (s) dropped from the front of COLD-START runs only (gen_alternating segment 0, or any run_gen trajectory; detected from ic.json segment_id). Measured one-step persistence after an impulsive start: 1.635 at 0-0.05s, 0.829 at 0.1-0.2s, 0.301 at 0.2-0.4s, 0.077 at 0.4-0.7s, 0.012 at 0.7-1.0s, i.e. the field settles by ~0.7s, a 140x drop. The cut is in SIM TIME not frames because a segment spans 30*save_t: at save_t=0.01 all 30 frames are transient, at save_t=0.2 only the first four are. Costs ~8.5% of the corpus; continuation segments are never touched.
training._distributed: Comms/DDP tuning. Each has an env override that WINS: HFM_ACCUM_STEPS, HFM_TRY_XCCL=1, HFM_GRAD_ALLREDUCE_BF16=1. On Dawn, scripts/dawn_task.sh sets the backend explicitly (shell env wins over these).
training._comms: Host-staged gloo is the floor: device collectives (oneCCL-ZE AND torch-native xccl) both GPU-fault (NotPresent/PDE, drm_neo.cpp:288) on compute-runtime 25.18.33578.77 -- see dawn_task.sh RE-TEST RESULT. try_xccl stays false until the runtime moves past 25.18. Meanwhile: accum_steps=2 halves how often the ~170MB host allreduce runs (effective batch 256 -> 512; lr left as-is, which errs conservative), and grad_allreduce_bf16 halves its size (division still fp32). Validation is sharded across ranks (batch i -> rank i%world), so it no longer parks 7 tiles behind rank 0.
training._gan: use_gan=false disables the discriminator completely (not built, trained, saved, or applied) — pure reconstruction training. Env HFM_USE_GAN=0/1 overrides.
training._disc_update_threshold: Discriminator strength cap. disc (the logged value) is the discriminator BCE loss: ~1.39 = chance, LOWER = stronger disc. The disc is only trained while threshold < d_loss < 2.0, so once it drops below the threshold it is frozen and the generator pulls it back up; it hovers at the threshold instead of collapsing toward 0 and overpowering the generator.
training._grad_weight: Gradient-difference loss |grad(pred) - grad(gt)|_1, masked to pairs where both pixels are fluid. Penalises WRONG gradients, so it suppresses grain (gradients absent from GT) without blurring sharp features (matching a steep true gradient REDUCES it). Enters the criterion, so the persistence baseline and the logged ratio include it consistently. 0 disables.
training._tile_weight: Tile-mean loss: the error field mean-pooled over the decoder's 16px token tiles (fluid-weighted), charged L2+L1. Targets the measured dominant artifact: per-tile DC offsets that are 80-90% of the rho error variance per step, spatially smooth at first, then decorrelating into a visible 16px blob grid ~10 rollout steps out. Pooling first makes the offset the penalised quantity instead of a rounding error inside pixel MSE. In the criterion, so persistence baselines and the ratio include it consistently.
